verdict.rationale: Orama's GitHub feature list includes Pinning Rules (Merchandising) and Fields Boosting, so developers can apply some manual ranking rules. Field boosting still weights textual matches, though, and filters and facets narrow results rather than re-rank them. Nothing shows ranking driven by numeric business signals. Missing for 10: score boosting by numeric attributes such as popularity, recency or margin; a custom ranking function or rules API; detailed docs on how pinning rules work; independent or hands-on corroboration.
